name: General Tsos Chicken
assumptions: Recipe instructions and listed ingredients indicate a batter for the chicken and a separate sauce; combined they serve a typical family-style Chinese stir-fry dish for 4 people.
Preparation and cooking steps (sauce mixing, marinating, deep-frying, stir-frying) conservatively total 45 minutes.
Plain flour classified as wheat-containing; starch assumed to be cornstarch (gluten-free).

Duck sauce, hoisin (in instructions), soy sauce, and sesame oil introduce ambiguous fish/shellfish potential from fermented ingredients but marked null only where truly unspecified; no explicit fish or shellfish items listed.
No dairy ingredients present; all other diet flags incompatible due to chicken, egg, wheat, and soy.
Servings null in source; estimated from standard General Tso's chicken recipes with 1.5 lb chicken.
instructions:
DIRECTIONS:
STEP 1 - SAUCE
In a bowl, add 2 Cups of water, 2 Tablespoon soy sauce, 2 Tablespoon white vinegar, sherry cooking wine, 1/4 Teaspoon white pepper, minced ginger, minced garlic, hot pepper, ketchup, hoisin sauce, and sugar.
Mix together well and set aside.
STEP 2 - MARINATING THE CHICKEN
In a bowl, add the chicken, 1 pinch of salt, 1 pinch of white pepper, 2 egg whites, and 3 Tablespoon of corn starch
STEP 3 - DEEP FRY THE CHICKEN
Deep fry the chicken at 350 degrees for 3-4 minutes or until it is golden brown and loosen up the chicken so that they don't stick together.
Set the chicken aside.
STEP 4 - STIR FRY
Add the sauce to the wok and then the broccoli and wait until it is boiling.
To thicken the sauce, whisk together 2 Tablespoon of cornstarch and 4 Tablespoon of water in a bowl and slowly add to your stir-fry until it's the right thickness.
Next add in the chicken and stir-fry for a minute and serve on a plate
